description: Na₃SbF₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent F atoms. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.11 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.17 Å) and two longer (2.25 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent F atoms. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.18 Å. Sb is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.24 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Sb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Sb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Sb atom.
